task: FT_New_Face on a crafted Windows .FON/.FNT (PE resource directory); the 16-bit sum number_of_id_entries + number_of_named_entries overflows in fnt_face_get_dll_font (src/winfonts/winfnt.c), producing an endless/OOB resource-entry iteration. Single file; fixes upstream #1462.
